append.detail: PART 1 2026-10-26: SITE_DESIGN is gone from 18 pages and layouts under app/(marketing) and app/for, and six pages left the marketing-kit baseline (subscribe, go/[door], rsvp/[token], mindless, vs, vs/[slug]; 1 remains: pricing). Held back on purpose: spaces, the-community and pricing, because check:render-path still lists them as editable pages and their DAWN branch is the only thing that renders BlockRender for them; dropping the branch needs a ruling on whether the page editor keeps those three slugs. Now unimported and left for the dead-code sweep: components/marketing/funnel/niche-funnel, app/(marketing)/pricing/pricing-sections.tsx, subscribe/confirm/confirm-button.tsx, start/[flow]/persona-chooser.tsx, rsvp/[token]/form.tsx. Still open: app/(public), app/discover, app/(help), and those three pages.
